title: WindBorne wins a hefty US Air Force contract for its balloon data | TechCrunch
summary: WindBorne currently has about 700 weather balloons flying around the globe, collecting atmospheric sensor readings that the company sells to customers and also feeds into its own AI weather forecasting model.
